queries: WITH site_ratio AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count FROM scanmesh m JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat HAVING AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) IS NOT NULL), status_avg AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio FROM site_ratio GROUP BY insurstat) SELECT r.insurstat, AVG(r.avg_ratio) AS above_avg_sites_avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS above_avg_site_count, AVG(r.avg_ratio - a.status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_over_status_avg FROM site_ratio r JOIN status_avg a ON a.insurstat = r.insurstat WHERE r.avg_ratio > a.status_avg_ratio GROUP BY r.insurstat

WITH site_ratio AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(m.facetresmm * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_avg AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio FROM site_ratio WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL GROUP BY insurstat) SELECT r.insurstat, AVG(r.avg_ratio) AS above_avg_sites_avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS above_avg_site_count, AVG(r.avg_ratio - a.status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_over_status_avg FROM site_ratio r JOIN status_avg a ON a.insurstat = r.insurstat WHERE r.avg_ratio > a.status_avg_ratio GROUP BY r.insurstat

WITH site_stats AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(m.facetresmm * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), site_ratios AS (SELECT * FROM site_stats WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL), status_avg AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio FROM site_ratios GROUP BY insurstat) SELECT r.insurstat, AVG(r.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_above, COUNT(*) AS site_count, AVG(r.avg_ratio - a.status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess FROM site_ratios r JOIN status_avg a ON a.insurstat = r.insurstat WHERE r.avg_ratio > a.status_avg_ratio GROUP BY r.insurstat

assumptions.assumption: A ratio is missing when facetresmm or geomdeltamm is NULL, or when geomdeltamm is 0 (division by zero is treated as missing via NULLIF). The site ratio is the average of the per-mesh ratios, not the ratio of the averages.

Sites whose ratios are all missing have no site ratio. They are left out of the status average and of the above-average sites. Their meshes still count toward mesh_count, which is computed but not shown in the final output.
A NULL insurstat counts as 'no recorded insurance status' and is excluded. Empty-string statuses are treated as real values.

assumptions.assumption: A mesh record's ratio is facetresmm / geomdeltamm. A zero geomdeltamm counts as a missing ratio (NULLIF), and so does a null in either column.
Mesh count is the number of all matched mesh records for the site, including those whose ratio is missing. It is not used in the final output.
Sites with no ratio at all are left out of the status average because the ratio is NULL, and they cannot be above average. Sites with a NULL insurstat are excluded.

assumptions.assumption: A mesh record with geomdeltamm = 0 is treated as having a missing ratio (NULLIF), and NULL ratios are ignored in the per-site average.

Sites whose every ratio is missing have no site ratio, so they are excluded from the status average and from the above-average set. The mesh count is computed per site (all joined mesh records) but does not appear in the final output.
Sites with no insurance status means insurstat IS NULL. Empty strings are treated as a real status.
